t2_stage.name: LEARNED_OPERATOR_ORACLE_SUPPORT_FROZEN_T1_EXECUTOR
t2_stage.causal_question: Can frozen natural-language semantic hidden states recover the ordered relation, requested role, operation, and applicability/control operator required by the proven frozen T1 executor while structural support and focus binding remain oracle?

architecture_rules.why_continuous_not_injected_yet: T1 was trained with zero operator-context vectors. Injecting a newly learned varying context into the frozen executor would confound the T2 operator-extraction causal question. The continuous latent remains available for later integrated QSRE stages.

research_alignment.SALR_2609_20398: retain continuous latent reasoning while aligning to explicit migratable schema/operator anchors; avoid premature hard textual commitment
research_alignment.LatentRefusal_2026: intermediate frozen hidden states can expose sparse decision signals that pooled/final representations miss

research_alignment.rule: These are architectural precedents only. A.L.I.C.E. design remains driven by its own causal evidence and full EIPM workload envelope.
